decisions.reason: Premium customer support is central to the firm's managed-service and 24/7 expert-help positioning, so it is more likely to be retained or folded deeper into core packages than withdrawn.

The software version management tool fits the firm's hosting, administration, and automation capabilities, although as a standalone offer it faces some risk of being absorbed into the broader platform.

The data processing contract tool is relatively far from the firm's hosting-centered core business and is the clearest candidate to discontinue so effort can be redirected to core platform and support development.
Scalable hosting for agencies directly matches the firm's target customers and stated strategic focus, making it the least likely product to be taken off the market.
